example: An evidence record has determination true and a current definition input. After the definition changes, validation reports stale evidence without modifying the record. {cite}`requirements.definitions.inputs`
rationale:
The example `requirements.definitions.reassessment` describes a concrete case: a record with determination true and current definition inputs. It says that after the definition changes, validation reports stale evidence and leaves the record unmodified. It cites `requirements.definitions.inputs`, which requires validation to reject changed snapshot text and to name the definition.

`tests/definitions.rs#fn[cyclic_dependencies_are_required_once_and_changes_require_review]` carries a {test} reference to the example. It checks each part of the scenario:
- **Setup.** `fixture` builds `glossary.a` and `glossary.b`. `capture` records definition inputs for both, and `approve` sets `determination` to true. Validation then returns no errors, so the inputs are current.
- **Moved definition.** Prepending blank lines to the glossary still validates with no errors. This matches the requirement that moving an unchanged definition must not invalidate its snapshot.
- **Changed definitions.** Three edits are made:
  - Changing the phrase of `b` is reported against `glossary.b`.
  - Changing the body text of `a` is reported against `glossary.a`.
  - Changing the body text of `b` is reported against `glossary.b`.
  
  After each edit the test asserts that some error contains "input text changed" and the definition name. This is the stale-evidence report, and it identifies the definition as `requirements.definitions.inputs` requires.
- **Record unmodified.** After each stale validation the test asserts that `before == fs::read(&path)`. The record is byte-identical, so validation did not rewrite it.
- **Reassessment.** The test re-runs `capture`, approves again, and validates clean. This is supporting behavior.

The test also checks missing definitions ("found 0") and duplicate definitions ("found 2"), which lie within the cited `requirements.definitions.inputs`. I found no outcome stated in the example that the assertions would let pass incorrectly.

text: An evidence record has determination true and a current definition input. After the definition changes, validation reports stale evidence without modifying the record. {cite}`requirements.definitions.inputs`

Evidence inputs MAY have a definition form containing exactly `definition` and `text`. `definition` MUST identify one named definition; `text` MUST contain its complete raw fenced declaration as source lines, including its phrase option and explanatory body.

Validation MUST reject missing definitions and changed snapshot text, identifying the definition and showing a compact diff when available. Moving an unchanged definition within its chapter MUST NOT invalidate its snapshot. Evidence displays MUST show the definition name, current source location, and recorded text.
